data.title: 2025 income tax assessment – refund of €312.45
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt issued the 2025 income tax assessment dated 15 September 2026. Tax is set at €1,234.00, and a refund of €312.45 will be paid to your account at Musterbank eG.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2025. More tax was withheld from your wages (€1,546.45) than was due (€1,234.00), so you get €312.45 back. No payment is needed. Check that the figures match your expectations. For example, the standard employee allowance (€1,230) was applied because your work equipment costs (€412) did not exceed it. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) within one month of notification; the app shows the deadline. Keep the notice. A tax adviser can help if unsure.
